spanish: o se le hubiere hecho saber su pecado que pecó en ella, y traerá su ofrenda, macho cabrío de cabras, macho íntegro.

findings.issue: hubiere is subjunctive conditional smoothing of the hophal perfect; the passive causative remains 'was made known'

notes: The clause follows the packet: or, made known to him, his sin that he sinned in her, and he shall bring his offering, buck of goats, male, whole.
